description: Use when someone wants to adopt a dog from a shelter in Germany, e.g. 'adopt a dog in Berlin' or 'Hund aus dem Tierheim adoptieren Bayern'. Searches dogs currently listed for adoption by German partner shelters on HonestDog (coverage is still small — a few shelters, mostly mixed breeds), by breed (German or English), size, gender, or Bundesland. Returns name, photos (only where the shelter consented), age in years, size, shelter and the honestdog.de listing URL; adoption happens with the shelter via the linked pages. / Durchsucht die aktuell zur Adoption gelisteten Tierheimhunde nach Rasse, Größe, Geschlecht oder Bundesland.

breed_text.description: Breed in German or English, umlauts optional (e.g. 'Schäferhund', 'german shepherd', 'Mischling'); matched against the shelter's breed text and HonestDog's breed catalogue

size.description: Size class (shelters list sizes in German; mapped server-side)

state.description: German Bundesland of the shelter, e.g. 'Nordrhein-Westfalen' (English names like 'North Rhine-Westphalia' are mapped)

name: search_shelter_dogs
title: Search adoptable shelter dogs
